adapterChanges.source/src/api-client.js: Scoped absolute API base and opt-in native chunk upload for byte-exact large JSON/binary bodies; normalize legacy routes without modifying global fetch.
adapterChanges.source/src/client.js: Opt-in codexRefresh export reloads host settings/fonts and selected-item inventory, preserving upstream pending-write and local-edit guards.
adapterChanges.source/src/persistence.js: Optional canAdopt callback prevents cross-client refresh overwriting a drag started while a settings GET is in flight; normal calls unchanged.
adapterChanges.source/src/fontset-store.js: Same optional canAdopt guard for active font-set refresh; normal startup unchanged.
adapterChanges.source/src/font/apply.js: Optional scoped Codex component availability hook; original DSH font probing remains unchanged without the hook.
adapterChanges.source/packages/fonts/src/appearance-fon: Native capability hook explains unavailable canvas terminal font controls without changing ordinary DSH UI.
adapterChanges.source/src/live-layer.js: Scene and Web frame, payload and entry URLs use the authenticated native or loopback API base.
adapterChanges.source/src/video-layer.js: Transcoded media URLs retain the authenticated API prefix.
adapterChanges.source/runtime-deps/webwallgl: Scoped local-assets and diagnostic paths preserve the Codex capability mount, retaining original DSH default paths elsewhere.
adapterChanges.source/lib/media-origin.js: Reuse authenticated primary /dsh/token mount; never start a secondary unprotected media listener.
adapterChanges.source/node_modules/dsh-plugin-wallpaper: Local ESM package-resolution wrappers for all seven original subpackages.
adapterChanges.source/node_modules/webwallgl: Recreated at runtime from source/runtime-deps/webwallgl, pinned WebWallGL 3.0.0 and its license.
